guides.wedding-invitation-maker.title: صياغة دعوة الزفاف: ما الذي يوضع في كل جزء
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.desc: الأسطر الأساسية في دعوة الزفاف، وكيفية صياغة أسماء المضيفين والمرافقات والردود RSVP وقواعد اللباس، وال التفاصيل التي توضع على الموقع الإلكتروني بدلًا من…
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.lead: تجيب الدعوة عن مَن، ومتى، وأين، وكيف ترد. وكل ما عدا ذلك يُنقل إلى موقع الزفاف الإلكتروني.
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.f1v: المضيفون، وأسماء الزوجين، والتاريخ، والوقت، ومكان الحفل، وتعليمات الرد
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.f2v: أرسل الدعوة قبل ستة إلى ثمانية أسابيع من الزفاف
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.f3v: حدد موعدًا نهائيًا للرد قبل ثلاثة إلى أربعة أسابيع
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.f4v: Address the envelope by name; do not write 'and guest' if undecided
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.s1: Write the invitation around the host line: whoever is named first is understood to be hosting, so coordinate with both families before printing. Keep the date spelled out, include the ceremony start time rather than guest arrival, and give a single clear reply method. Put directions, accommodation, registry and FAQs on the website and print only its short URL.
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.s2: US invitations commonly include a separate response card and a reception card; UK invitations often come as a single formal card with 'RSVP' and may use 'RSVP' or 'The favour of a reply is requested'. Day guests and evening guests are frequently invited separately in the UK and Ireland, with different times on each card. For multilingual families, a bilingual card or a translated insert avoids relying on guests to parse a date format.
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.s3: Do not print a dress code that is stricter than the venue requires, and do not use 'adults only' on the main card — address the envelope precisely and put the policy on the website. Avoid numeric dates for international guests, and proofread the venue postcode, the website URL and the RSVP date three times. Order a few spare envelopes; hand-addressing errors are inevitable.
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.q1: When should wedding invitations be sent?
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.a1: Six to eight weeks before the day, with an RSVP deadline three to four weeks out. Send earlier for a destination wedding.
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.a2: By naming the guest on the envelope. If the invitation is addressed to one person only, it is understood to be for one.
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.q3: What belongs on the wedding website?
guides.wedding-invitation-maker.a3: Travel, accommodation, parking, schedule, registry, FAQs, dress code detail and any accessibility or dietary information.
